_comment: Harvest (Horticrafting) reforges for rare items. RePoE doesn't export Harvest crafts, so this file is written by hand.
Source: Path of Exile wiki, 'Harvest crafting' and 'Horticrafting Station' (https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Harvest_crafting), as of patch 3.2x.
The wiki couldn't be fetched from the build environment, so the list below was written from that page's known contents and is NOT re-verified.
approximate: true makes the app label every Harvest plan as approximate.
moreCommonMultiplier: how much more likely the craft's tag mods are for the rest of the roll. The game only says 'more common'; 10 matches the x10 of a fossil's 'more' and is an assumption.
cost: lifeforce amounts change between patches and are left out until verified (null). The app then shows 'see the Horticrafting Station' and can't rank these crafts by cost.
reforgeTagText: Reforge a Rare item with new random modifiers, including a {name} modifier. {name} modifiers are more common

reforgeKeep.text: Reforge a Rare item, keeping all Prefixes
Reforge a Rare item, keeping all Suffixes
